# Valesų gerovė

Valesų gerovė is a unique Lithuanian wellness brand that bridges ancient Baltic traditions with cutting-edge biohacking technology. The brand creates a mystical 'Ancient-Future' experience, combining traditional forest remedies (like Chaga tinctures and birch bud extracts) with modern science-backed supplements and wearable health devices. The aesthetic merges deep Baltic forest imagery with digital neural networks and bio-luminescent accents, creating a distinctive dual-pathway shopping experience that respects Lithuanian heritage while embracing technological innovation.

Source: https://valesugerove.lt

## Two pathways, one standard of care.


We bring together heritage craft and careful sourcing, honouring Lithuanian traditions while keeping every product honest, traceable and clearly described.











### Forest Rituals


Rooted in Baltic heritage, our traditional remedies honour centuries of craft passed down through generations of Lithuanian foragers and forest keepers.


- Carefully selected teas, honey and botanicals with clear, traceable origins

- Seasonal harvesting aligned with natural rhythms

- Traditional preparation methods, kept true to heritage

- A gentle, everyday place for plants in the modern home

- Origin-first sourcing from trusted Lithuanian foragers











### Biohacking Protocols


A curated selection of modern supplements and wellness tools, chosen for honest sourcing and clear, transparent information.


- Contemporary supplements chosen with careful, transparent criteria

- Modern wellness tools for everyday routine

- Honest product information in Lithuanian and English

- Third-party documentation and certificates for every batch

- Clear, honest origin and composition details

Our Roots


## Lithuanian herbal tradition, shared with the world


Lithuania has a living culture of gathering and using meadow and forest plants, teas and honey. Our mission is to keep this traditional culture alive for Lithuanians and to bring it closer to people around the world, working with small Lithuanian producers.













### Gathered from meadows & forests


Our plants are hand-harvested in small batches from certified wild meadows and forest clearings across Lithuania. Chamomile, linden blossom, yarrow, raspberry leaf, and fireweed are gathered at their peak, following seasonal rhythms passed down through generations.








### Crafted with patience


Drying, blending, and packaging are done by hand in small family workshops. We work directly with Lithuanian producers who honour slow, traditional methods — air-drying herbs on linen racks and blending teas in wooden bowls.
















### Honey from wildflower meadows


Our honey comes from apiaries placed near protected wildflower meadows and linden groves. The bees forage on a diverse range of native blossoms, producing honey that carries the distinct character of the Lithuanian landscape.








### Sourced with respect


Every herb, tea, and jar of honey is traceable to its origin. We visit our partner producers, learn their methods, and ensure that harvesting practices protect the natural balance of Lithuania's meadows and forests for future generations.










From small Lithuanian producers, with care and tradition.



Heritage · Origin · Craft · Sourcing









## From forest to shelf: our craft.


We trace every ingredient from harvest to your hands, honouring Lithuanian traditions while keeping sourcing and documentation open and honest. Each step is about care for the plants and clarity for you.




1


### Seasonal harvesting


We gather Chaga, birch buds and forest botanicals at their traditional harvest times, following long-practised Lithuanian rhythms and the natural growing seasons.





2


### Gentle preparation


Cold-pressing and low-temperature methods keep the plants close to how they were gathered, without the use of chemical solvents.





3


### Certificates & batch documentation


We ask producers for certificates and batch documentation, so the origin and composition of each ingredient is recorded and traceable.





4


### Clear, honest product information


Clear, honest product information in Lithuanian and English, so what you read on the label is what you find inside.






We choose products that honour heritage and are described honestly.























## Trusted for honest sourcing and traditional craft.


Every product we offer is described honestly, with clear origins and careful sourcing. We share the craft and the story behind each remedy — never promises beyond the label.

# A Lithuanian apothecary mindset, kept for today.


Valesų Gerovė brings Lithuania's botanical heritage together with carefully selected supplements and modern technology, curated by Ron Yaffe, ND, internationally active naturopath with over 25 years of clinical experience. Every product begins with the deep botanical knowledge passed down through Baltic generations — Chaga gathered from birch forests, wild berry teas, and herbal preparations that have sustained our ancestors. We then bring them together with thoughtfully selected supplements and modern wellness tools, while keeping everything traceable: honest documentation, clear origins, and product information you can rely on.


This is our 'Ancient-Future' philosophy. We don't ask you to choose between heritage craft and the modern world. Instead we bring them together — honouring traditional preparation methods alongside advanced supplements and modern wellness technology, while keeping sourcing and product details clear and honest. The result is a collection of teas, honey, supplements and carefully chosen wellness products that respect where we come from.













## Where folklore meets careful craft.


Our journey begins in the quiet spaces between tradition and the modern world — where centuries-old Lithuanian craft meets clearer, more open ways of sharing it. We honour the rhythms of our ancestors while being thorough and transparent about everything we offer.


Every product we offer carries this dual commitment: to preserve the integrity of our heritage and to keep our sourcing and product information clear and honest. This is not compromise — it is the careful craft that defines who we are.





### Heritage


We follow seasonal rhythms, source ingredients from local ecosystems, and maintain deep respect for the ecological balance that sustains us. Our products honour traditional preparation methods passed down through generations of Baltic foragers.









### Careful sourcing


Every botanical is documented for origin and composition. We keep certificates and batch information, and offer clear, honest product descriptions so you always know exactly what you're buying.





We believe in clear expectations and honest communication. When you choose Valesų gerovė, you're choosing a partner who respects both the wisdom of the past and the responsibility of the present.























## Principles that guide every choice we make.


Our commitment to you is rooted in transparency, honesty and respect for the wisdom of our ancestors. Every product we offer is considered against these core principles.









### Traceability


Every ingredient is sourced with complete transparency. From Lithuanian forest harvests to carefully chosen products, we document the entire journey from origin to your hands.








### Honest guidance


We put clear information first. Each product comes with honest, complete descriptions of its origin and composition, so you always know what you're choosing.








### Respect for tradition


Baltic craft has sustained our ancestors for centuries. We honour these time-honoured products while keeping their story and sourcing clear, building a bridge between ancient knowledge and the contemporary world.













Our Heritage

## Lithuanian herbal tradition, shared with the world


Lithuania has a living culture of gathering and using meadow and forest plants, teas and honey. Our mission is to keep this traditional culture alive for Lithuanians and to bring it closer to people around the world, working with small Lithuanian producers.










### Meadow & Forest Gathering


For generations, Lithuanian families have walked the same meadows and forest edges to hand-gather chamomile, linden blossom, yarrow and wild mint. This careful, seasonal practice follows natural rhythms and respects the land.










### Small Producer Craft


We partner exclusively with small Lithuanian producers who dry herbs slowly at low temperatures, blend teas by hand, and keep honey raw and unprocessed. Each jar and pouch carries the name of the family that made it.










### Honey & Botanicals


Lithuanian meadow honey reflects the wild flora of the region — linden, buckwheat, raspberry and forest herbs. We source raw honey from apiaries that practice traditional, bee-centred beekeeping.







We describe heritage, origin, plants, craft and sourcing only. We make no health, medical or performance claims about our products.









## Small team, meticulous sourcing.


Every product we offer passes through careful hands — people who understand both forest craft and clear, honest documentation. Our team curates, documents and informs, ensuring that each tea, honey and product is traceable and honestly described. We believe in transparency, origin and the power of informed choices.









### Herbal traditions researcher


Documents Baltic forest traditions, specialising in Chaga, birch and pine products, and keeps traditional preparation methods alive with careful sourcing and clear records.








### Product information advisor


Reviews every product's composition and origin against clear, honest criteria, and translates detailed information into plain language so customers understand what they are choosing.








### Quality & sourcing lead


Oversees every step from forest harvest to final packaging. Verifies supplier credentials, documentation and ethical sourcing practices, ensuring transparency and traceability for every ingredient and product we offer.








### Community guidance


Listens to customer questions, shares the story and origins of our products, and builds trust through honest conversations — connecting people who love Baltic tradition with clear, truthful information.













## Ask for a selection that fits your taste and daily life.


Share your tastes, preferences and daily rhythms with us. Whether you're exploring traditional Baltic botanicals or carefully chosen modern wellness products, we'll help you find a starting point that honours both tradition and honest information.

Contact










Empowering your journey to optimal health through science-backed wellness and biohacking solutions.

# Verification standards and responsible guidance.


At Valesų gerovė, we bridge ancestral Lithuanian wisdom with contemporary research protocols. Every recommendation—from traditional Chaga tinctures to modern nootropics—undergoes rigorous sourcing verification and evidence review. Our approach combines ethnobotanical heritage with peer-reviewed studies, creating pragmatic protocols that honor both Baltic forest knowledge and biohacking science.


All information provided is for educational purposes and should not be considered medical advice. If you have existing health conditions, take medications, or are pregnant or nursing, please consult a qualified healthcare professional before starting any new supplement or wellness protocol. Our team is here to guide, but your physician knows your unique health situation best.















## Traditional remedies vs modern stacks—how we combine them.


Both pathways offer profound benefits when applied thoughtfully. Our approach respects the wisdom of Baltic forest traditions while embracing the precision of contemporary biohacking—creating personalized wellness plans that honor your unique needs.







Consideration
Traditional Forest Remedy Approach
Modern Biohacking Approach




Primary intent
Restore balance through seasonal alignment; support the body's natural rhythms with plant wisdom passed down through generations
Optimize specific biomarkers and performance metrics; achieve measurable improvements in energy, cognition, and recovery


Timing & seasonality
Deeply tied to harvest cycles—spring birch sap, summer herbs, autumn mushrooms, winter roots; each season brings its own medicine
Protocol-driven schedules based on circadian biology, fasting windows, and personal data; less dependent on external seasons


Typical evidence sources
Centuries of empirical use, herbalist knowledge, ethnobotanical records, and anecdotal family traditions
Clinical trials, peer-reviewed studies, quantified self-experiments, and real-time wearable device feedback


Measurement
Subjective wellness indicators—how you feel, sleep quality, energy levels, mental clarity observed over weeks or months
Objective biomarkers—blood panels, HRV tracking, sleep architecture data, cognitive test scores, continuous glucose monitoring


Safety considerations
Generally gentle with long safety history; requires proper plant identification and awareness of individual sensitivities or allergies
Highly controlled dosing with known safety profiles; potential for supplement interactions and need for professional guidance with advanced stacks


Who it may not suit
Those seeking rapid, quantifiable results; individuals who prefer standardized protocols over intuitive, seasonal approaches
Those overwhelmed by data tracking; individuals seeking holistic, spiritual connection rather than optimization metrics


How we recommend starting
Begin with one seasonal remedy (like Chaga tea or birch bud extract); observe how your body responds over 4-6 weeks before adding more
Establish baseline measurements first; introduce one supplement or device at a time; track changes systematically for 2-3 weeks

The most effective wellness journey often weaves both pathways together—honoring ancestral wisdom while leveraging modern precision. We help you discover which combination serves your unique constitution, lifestyle, and goals, creating a personalized plan that feels both grounded and forward-thinking.













## What we document and why it matters.


Every product in our catalog undergoes rigorous verification. We record supplier origins, test for contaminants, and document the scientific rationale behind each formulation. This transparency ensures you receive safe, effective supplements backed by evidence and ethical sourcing.







### Identity confirmation


We verify botanical species through DNA barcoding and chemical fingerprinting, ensuring each herb matches its label claim. Certificates of analysis are stored for every batch.






### Contaminant awareness


Third-party labs test for heavy metals, pesticides, and microbial contamination. We publish limits of detection and actual measured values for transparency.






### Batch notes


Each production run receives a unique identifier linking to harvest date, extraction method, and storage conditions. You can trace your supplement from field to bottle.






### Supplier traceability


We maintain direct relationships with foragers and farms, documenting geographic origin and harvesting practices. Ethical wildcrafting and sustainable cultivation are non-negotiable.






### Protocol rationale


Every formulation is backed by peer-reviewed research. We cite studies, explain dosage selection, and outline the biological mechanisms behind each ingredient's effects.






### Interaction caution


We document known contraindications, drug interactions, and potential side effects. Our database cross-references medications and health conditions to flag safety concerns proactively.














## Common questions.


We've gathered answers to the most frequently asked questions about combining ancient Baltic remedies with modern biohacking practices. These responses are designed to help you navigate your wellness journey safely and thoughtfully.






### Can I combine forest extracts with supplements?


In many cases, yes—traditional extracts like Chaga tinctures and birch bud preparations can complement modern supplements. However, it's essential to understand potential interactions. We recommend starting with one category at a time and monitoring how your body responds. If you're taking prescription medications or have specific health conditions, please consult with a healthcare professional before combining remedies. Our team can provide guidance on timing and dosing to minimize any potential conflicts.





### How do you think about medications and interactions?


We take medication interactions very seriously. Some forest botanicals can affect how your body processes pharmaceuticals—for example, certain adaptogens may influence blood pressure or blood sugar regulation. We always recommend informing your doctor about any herbal supplements you're considering. Our product descriptions include known interaction warnings, but they're not exhaustive. When in doubt, schedule a consultation with a healthcare provider who understands both traditional remedies and modern pharmacology.





### How soon should I expect changes?


This varies significantly based on what you're addressing and which products you're using. Some nootropics and biohacking devices may show effects within days—improved focus, better sleep tracking data, or enhanced recovery metrics. Traditional forest extracts often work more gradually, with noticeable shifts appearing over 2-4 weeks of consistent use. We encourage keeping a simple journal to track subtle changes in energy, mood, and physical markers. Remember that wellness is a journey, not a destination, and sustainable change takes time.





### Do wearables replace intuition?


Absolutely not—wearables are tools that enhance, rather than replace, your body's wisdom. The best approach combines objective data from devices with subjective awareness of how you feel. Your HRV reading might indicate stress, but only you know if that stress is productive or harmful. We view technology as a modern extension of the intuitive practices our ancestors used—observing patterns, respecting natural rhythms, and making adjustments based on lived experience. Use the data to inform your choices, but always listen to your body first.





### What is a safe starting routine?


We recommend beginning with just one or two products and establishing a baseline for at least two weeks. A gentle starting point might be a morning adaptogen tincture paired with basic sleep tracking. Avoid the temptation to implement everything at once—this makes it impossible to identify what's actually helping. Start with the lowest recommended dose, especially for concentrated extracts. Pay attention to how you feel, and increase gradually only if needed. If you experience any adverse reactions, discontinue use and consult a healthcare professional.





### How do you handle sensitivities?


Individual sensitivities are common and completely valid. We provide detailed ingredient lists and sourcing information for all our products, including potential allergens and cross-contamination risks. If you have known sensitivities to specific plants or compounds, please review product details carefully or contact us before purchasing. For those with multiple chemical sensitivities, we suggest starting with single-ingredient products rather than complex formulations. We're happy to recommend alternatives or create a customized approach that respects your body's unique needs.













## Get a cautious, personalized starting plan.


Share your wellness goals and any constraints with us, and we'll create a conservative first step that respects both ancient wisdom and modern science. Whether you're exploring herbal tinctures or top nootropics, we'll guide you safely.

# Return Policy

Last Updated: 10/17/2026

Seller: Valesų Gerovė, MB, company code 307168555, Žirmūnų g. 57-50, LT-09110 Vilnius, Lithuania

Return and contact address: Žalgirio g. 90, 6th floor, LT-09303 Vilnius, Lithuania

Email: info@valesugerove.lt

Phone: +370 4543 5643

## 1. Two Ways to Return

We offer two return routes:
- Your statutory 14-day right of withdrawal for distance contracts under EU and Lithuanian consumer law (see Section 2).
- Our voluntary 30-day return promise for unopened products (see Section 3).

## 2. Statutory Right of Withdrawal

You have the right to withdraw from this contract within 14 calendar days without giving any reason. The withdrawal period expires 14 calendar days from the day on which you, or a person you name, receives the goods — or, if the order covers several goods delivered separately, the day on which you or that person receives the last good.

To exercise the right of withdrawal, you must inform us of your decision by an unequivocal statement (for example, a letter sent by post or an email to info@valesugerove.lt). You must dispatch the goods back to our return address without undue delay and in any event no later than 14 days after telling us of your withdrawal.

Return costs: You bear the direct cost of returning the goods (except where the goods are faulty — see Section 5).

Refund: We will reimburse all payments received from you, including the cost of standard delivery, no later than 14 calendar days from the day on which we are informed of your decision to withdraw. We will carry out that reimbursement using the same means of payment as you used for the initial transaction. We may withhold reimbursement until we have received the goods back or you have supplied evidence of having sent back the goods, whichever is the earliest.

Exceptions — the right of withdrawal does not apply to:
- Sealed goods which are not suitable for return due to health protection or hygiene reasons and which were unsealed after delivery.
- Goods that deteriorate rapidly or whose expiry date would expire.

Loss in value: You are only liable for any diminished value of the goods resulting from handling which is not necessary to establish the nature, characteristics and functioning of the goods.

## 3. Our Voluntary 30-Day Return Promise

In addition to your statutory rights, we accept returns of unopened products in their original packaging within 30 days of delivery. This is a voluntary commercial commitment; it does not limit, replace or affect your statutory right of withdrawal described in Section 2. Refunds under this promise will be made to the original payment method.

## 4. How to Return
- Email us at info@valesugerove.lt with your order number and the items you wish to return.
- We will reply with return instructions.
- Pack the goods securely and send them to our return address: Žalgirio g. 90, 6th floor, LT-09303 Vilnius, Lithuania.
- Return shipping costs are borne by you, except for faulty or non-conforming goods (see Section 5).

## 5. Damaged or Defective Goods

If you receive goods that are damaged or do not conform to the contract, please contact us at info@valesugerove.lt with your order number and photographs of the issue as soon as possible.

Your legal guarantee rights under Lithuanian consumer law remain fully intact. Where goods do not conform to the contract, you are entitled to have them repaired or replaced, or — where repair or replacement is not possible — to a proportionate price reduction or termination of the contract. Non-conformity appearing within two years of delivery is covered. We will bear all return costs for goods that are faulty or non-conforming.

## 6. Refund Timing

Refunds are processed as described in Section 2 — within 14 calendar days of us receiving your withdrawal notice (subject to receipt of the goods or proof of dispatch). Please note that your bank or payment provider may require a few additional business days to credit the amount to your account.

## 7. Complaints


If you have a complaint, please contact us first at info@valesugerove.lt — we aim to resolve all issues promptly.

If we are unable to resolve your complaint, consumers may contact the State Consumer Rights Protection Authority (Valstybinė vartotojų teisių apsaugos tarnyba, VVTAT): vvtat.lt.

## 8. See Also

Please also read our Terms and Conditions of Sale for further information about your rights and our obligations.

# Privacy Policy
Last Updated:  10/17/2026
## 1. Who We Are

The controller responsible for your personal data is Valesų Gerovė, MB (Mažoji bendrija), company code 307168555, registered office Žirmūnų g. 57-50, LT-09110 Vilnius, Lithuania.

This policy applies to the website https://valesugerove.lt/ and all associated ordering, account and contact services operated by us.

We do not have a formally designated Data Protection Officer. All data protection queries should be directed to us directly:
- Correspondence address: Žalgirio g. 90, 6th floor, LT-09303 Vilnius, Lithuania
- Email: info@valesugerove.lt
- Phone: +370 45435643

## 2. What Data We Collect

We collect the following categories of personal data:
- Order data: your name, delivery and billing address, email address, phone number, items ordered and payment status. We never see or store your full card number — card payments are handled entirely by our payment providers.
- Contact and newsletter data: your name and email address when you submit a contact form or subscribe to our newsletter.
- Technical data: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data, collected via cookies and similar technologies (see Section 8).
- Account data: your name, email address and order history if you create a customer account on our website.

We do not ask for health or special-category data. Please do not include health information or any other sensitive personal data in contact forms or order notes.

## 3. Purposes and Legal Bases (GDPR Art. 6)

We process your personal data only where we have a lawful basis to do so:
- Processing and fulfilling your order — legal basis: performance of a contract with you (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
- Accounting and tax records — legal basis: compliance with a legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR), in particular Lithuanian accounting and tax legislation.
- Answering your enquiries — legal basis: our legitimate interest in responding to customers and potential customers (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR), or pre-contractual steps at your request (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). See Section 7 for your right to object.
- Newsletter and marketing emails — legal basis: your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). You may withdraw your consent at any time by clicking the unsubscribe link in any email or by writing to us. Withdrawal of consent does not affect the lawfulness of any processing carried out before the withdrawal.
- Analytics and non-essential cookies — legal basis: your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), given through our cookie banner. See Section 8 for details.
- Fraud prevention and security — legal basis: our legitimate interest in protecting our business and customers (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). See Section 7 for your right to object.

## 4. Recipients of Your Data

We share your personal data only where necessary, with the following categories of recipients:
- Website platform and hosting provider — for operating and maintaining the website.
- Payment providers: Mollie and PayPal — to process your payment securely. These providers have their own privacy policies.
- Carriers and logistics providers — to deliver your order to the address you specify.
- Our accountant — to fulfil our accounting and tax obligations.
- Our business email provider — for sending transactional and marketing emails.

We do not sell, rent or otherwise trade your personal data to third parties.

## 5. Transfers Outside the EEA

Some of our service providers (for example, PayPal) may transfer personal data to countries outside the European Economic Area (EEA). Where such transfers occur, we ensure they are protected by an adequacy decision of the European Commission or by Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission. Mollie is headquartered within the EEA and processes data in the EEA. If you would like a copy of the applicable SCCs or further information about a specific transfer, please contact us at info@valesugerove.lt.

## 6. Retention Periods

We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary:
- Order and accounting records — for 10 years, as required by the Lithuanian Law on Accounting (Buhalterinės apskaitos įstatymas) and applicable tax legislation.
- Newsletter subscribers — until you unsubscribe.
- Enquiries and account data — for as long as necessary to answer your enquiry, operate your account, resolve any disputes and comply with our legal obligations.

## 7. Your Rights

Under the GDPR, you have the following rights in relation to your personal data:
- Right of access — to obtain a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
- Right to rectification — to have inaccurate or incomplete data corrected.
- Right to erasure — to have your data deleted in certain circumstances.
- Right to restriction of processing — to limit how we use your data in certain circumstances.
- Right to data portability — to receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
- Right to object — to object to processing based on legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)) or for direct marketing purposes at any time.
- Right to withdraw consent — where processing is based on your consent, you may withdraw it at any time without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing.

To exercise any of these rights, please write to us at info@valesugerove.lt. We will respond within one month of receiving your request. For complex or numerous requests, we may extend this period by up to a further two months; if so, we will notify you within the first month and explain the reason for the delay.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Lithuanian supervisory authority: Valstybinė duomenų apsaugos inspekcija (VDAI), L. Sapiegos g. 17, 10312 Vilnius, email ada@ada.lt, website vdai.lrv.lt.

## 8. Cookies

Our website uses cookies and similar technologies. Strictly necessary cookies (for example to keep your basket and checkout session working) are used without consent because the site cannot work without them. All other cookies, including analytics and marketing cookies, are used only if you give your consent through our cookie banner (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR and the ePrivacy rules). You can accept or reject non-essential cookies equally easily, and you can change or withdraw your choice at any time through the cookie settings link in the page footer. Withdrawing consent does not affect processing carried out before withdrawal. Further details on individual cookies, including their lifetimes, are available in the cookie settings.

## 9. Contact Information

For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:
- Company: Valesų Gerovė, MB (company code 307168555)
- Email: info@valesugerove.lt

- Phone: +370 4543 5643
- Registered office: Žirmūnų g. 57-50, LT-09110 Vilnius, Lithuania
- Correspondence address: Žalgirio g. 90, 6th floor, LT-09303 Vilnius, Lithuania

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  March 14, 2026



Valesų gerovė is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: Valesų gerovė

- Email: info@valesugerove.lt

- Phone: +37045435643



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.

# Terms and Conditions of Sale


Last updated:  10/17/2026


These terms apply to purchases made on valesugerove.lt from Valesų Gerovė, MB.



## 1. Seller


- Company name: Valesų Gerovė, MB

- Company code: 307168555

- VAT number: LT100019995616

- Registered office: Žirmūnų g. 57-50, LT-09110 Vilnius, Lithuania

- Contact and correspondence address: Žalgirio g. 90, 6th floor, LT-09303 Vilnius, Lithuania

- Email: info@valesugerove.lt

- Phone: +370 4543 5643

- Website: valesugerove.lt




## 2. Scope


These terms apply to all purchases made on valesugerove.lt. Our products are food supplements and related wellness products. Food supplements are not medicines and do not replace a varied and balanced diet or medical care.


- If you are pregnant, breastfeeding, taking medication, or have a medical condition, speak to a doctor or pharmacist before use.

- Keep all products out of reach of young children.

- Do not exceed the recommended daily dose.




## 3. Orders and Contract


Your order is an offer to purchase. The contract between you and us is concluded when we send you an order confirmation by email. We may decline an order — for example due to stock errors or suspected fraud — and will refund any payment already made.


## 4. Prices and Payment


- Prices are shown in euros (EUR) and include VAT where applicable.

- The delivery cost is shown before you complete payment.

- We accept the payment methods shown at checkout. Payments are processed by Mollie and PayPal. We never see or store your full card number.




## 5. Delivery


Delivery countries, carriers, costs, and estimated delivery times are shown at checkout and in your order confirmation. Risk passes to you on delivery. Please check the parcel on receipt and notify us promptly about any damage.


## 6. Right of Withdrawal (Consumers)


You have the right to withdraw from this contract within 14 calendar days after you, or a person you name, receive the goods, without giving any reason. Where several goods are delivered separately, the period runs from the last delivery.


To exercise the right of withdrawal, send a clear statement to info@valesugerove.lt before the withdrawal period expires. You must return the goods within 14 days of notifying us. You bear the direct cost of returning goods.


We will refund all payments received from you, including the cost of standard delivery, within 14 calendar days of learning of your withdrawal, using the same payment method. We may withhold the refund until we receive the goods or you show proof of dispatch.


Exceptions: The right of withdrawal does not apply to sealed goods that are not suitable for return for health or hygiene reasons and were unsealed after delivery, nor to goods that spoil quickly or whose shelf life would expire.


You are liable for any loss in value of the goods resulting from handling beyond what is necessary to check their nature, characteristics, and functioning.


Model withdrawal form:


I hereby give notice that I withdraw from my contract for the sale of the following goods: [goods]. Ordered on [date], received on [date]. Name, address, date.


Our 30-day return promise:  In addition to your statutory right of withdrawal, we accept returns of unopened products in their original packaging within 30 days of delivery. This is a voluntary commitment and does not limit or replace the 14-day statutory right described above.



## 7. Defective Goods (Legal Guarantee)


Goods must match their description and be fit for their intended use. If they are not, you have rights under Lithuanian consumer law, including repair, replacement, a price reduction, or termination of the contract. We are liable for non-conformity that appears within two years of delivery. To make a claim, contact info@valesugerove.lt with your order number and photos of the defect.


## 8. Product Information and Health Statements


We describe our products using label information and include only health claims authorised under Regulation (EC) No 1924/2006. Educational content on this website is general information only and does not constitute medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.


## 9. Intellectual Property

Concept stage


# NaturoSync


### A Lithuania-based wellness technology project, currently in development.


A claim-free preview of a developing wellness technology concept.





Illustrative concept















The idea

## The idea



Valesų gerovė is a Lithuanian wellness brand built on a simple but powerful belief: the ancient wisdom of the Baltic forest and the precision of modern biohacking belong together. We create a space where traditional forest remedies—like chaga tinctures and birch bud extracts—sit alongside science-backed supplements and wearable health devices, offering a dual-pathway approach to wellbeing that respects heritage while embracing innovation.


Our name, meaning "wellness of the Valesa" or "forest grove," reflects this union. We honor the slow, quiet knowledge passed down through generations of Lithuanian herbalists, and we pair it with measurable, data-driven tools that help you understand your body on a deeper level. The result is an experience that feels both ancient and futuristic—a calm, premium apothecary where moss-green structure meets neon-amber action, and where every product tells a story of roots and resonance.










## How it is planned to work


The NaturoSync flow is a planned concept, not an available product. It illustrates how ancient Baltic wisdom and modern biohacking might one day meet in a single, personalised rhythm.






01





### Sense


Wearable devices and gentle self-tracking gather baseline signals — sleep depth, heart-rate variability, energy dips. The goal is a quiet, continuous read of your body's forest floor, not a flood of numbers.






02





### Understand


An app layer translates raw signals into clear patterns, connecting dots between stress, season, and lifestyle. It would highlight meaningful shifts — like the moment Chaga's adaptogenic support might truly help.






03





### Personalise


The system would suggest a tailored blend: a birch bud extract for spring renewal, a specific breathwork sequence for evenings, or a biohacking stack timed to your personal chronotype.






04





### Review


Over weeks, the loop would refine itself. You would see what worked, what faded, and how your body responded — a slow, respectful dialogue between ancestral remedies and real-time data.












## Where we are


Valesų gerovė is currently in active development. We are building a unique Lithuanian wellness platform that bridges ancient Baltic forest wisdom with the precision of modern biohacking. Our team is carefully sourcing Chaga tinctures, birch bud extracts, and other heritage remedies, while simultaneously integrating science-backed supplements and wearable health devices into a unified catalog experience.


The dual-pathway shopping experience is being refined so that every visitor can move seamlessly between traditional apothecary knowledge and lab-grade technological innovation. We are not rushing this process; the integrity of both worlds matters deeply to us.




Development notice

Our catalog and checkout are not yet live. We are currently finalizing product sourcing, testing user flows, and ensuring that every item meets our standards for both heritage authenticity and scientific rigor.


Not yet for sale.














## Stay informed


NaturoSync is currently in development, blending ancient Baltic forest wisdom with modern biohacking science. If you would like to ask about the project or receive updates as we progress, please reach out to Valesų gerovė directly.

Contact us

By contacting us, you can choose whether to consent to receiving a response or future project updates in line with GDPR.

Whether you are exploring herbal teas, botanical blends or wellness technology, our assistant will guide you through our products.
